title: Stock Market Today: Dow falls 170 points despite strong Goldman Sachs earnings; chip selloff deepens - MarketWatch
description: U.S. stocks are lower on Tuesday as JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo and Citigroup report financial results, while tech names are under pressure amid chip selloff.

title: ‘Crystal Lake’ and ‘Carrie’ deliver distinctly different scares - The Washington Post
description: Ahead of Halloween, a “Friday the 13th” reboot goes in for the campy kill, while an update on the Stephen King classic explores the horrors of social media.

title: Sean McVay is 'sick' about his overtime call as another Super Bowl coach publicly regrets end of game decision - Fox News
description: Sean McVay says he's "sick" after a third-down play call led to a blocked field goal in the Rams' overtime loss to the Buffalo Bills on Monday.

title: Former ‘SNL’ star Ego Nwodim mocks Shane Gillis monologue about women’s gym outfits - NBC News
description: Former “Saturday Night Live” cast member Ego Nwodim appeared to respond to Shane Gillis’ controversial monologue from his latest hosting stint Saturday, during which he said that women who wear short shorts to the gym are dressing like “whores.”

title: How Iran made the Houthis into such a problem for the U.S. and its allies - CBS News
description: 10 years ago, few people had heard of the Houthis. Here's how the Yemeni rebels have become Iran's "most powerful proxy."
